hints.title: Path Traversal Freedom
hints.text: Because roads can be visited multiple times in any order, any road belonging to the connected component containing cities 1 and n can be included in the path.

hints.title: Connected Component Scope
hints.text: The minimum score is simply the minimum weight among all edges that belong to the connected component containing node 1.

hints.title: Traversal Identification
hints.text: Run a breadth-first traversal from node 1 to discover all reachable cities, then find the smallest edge cost among all incident edges.

hints.title: Connected Component Edge Minimization Implementation

complexity.notes: Breadth-first search traverses the connected component in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Dijkstra shortest path search with bottlenecks is redundant since revisiting nodes and edges is allowed.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V + E) memory for graph adjacency lists.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that unrestricted path traversal reduces the problem to minimum edge in the connected component.
